purpose: Validate first-eligible tuning, indirect K reduction and separate recovery in actual advancing encounters; retain paired effect metrics without proposing a balance change.
baseline_deck: Same legal twenty-card deck frozen for the OFFLINE matrix: common C01-C11, C15, ET-FIRE-G, ET-WATER-G and class 01-06
pairing: Same hero, level-zero weapon/cards, empty equipment, strategy, seed, encounter inputs, information budget and 600-second observation limit; replace exactly one Green tuning card.
strategy: Current basic visible-hand subset selection; no library, future intent or RNG inspection
required_actual_event_checks: First eligible element and selected order
Tuning counts toward R and does not increase P
Other counter cards can lower same-core tuning K
Ordinary and conflict recovery independently rounded
Conflict recovery does not use Priest low-HP or weapon multiplier
required_case_denominators: Record applicable and non-applicable casts by case, hero, group, replacement and seed block; zero applicable events cannot pass a required case.
evidence: Preserve every actual cast input and contract result in bounded gzip JSONL parts plus encounter outcomes; original bytes, CRC, SHA256 and manifests required. No digest-only replacement for event evidence.

statistics.multiplicity: Holm across all 36 declared comparison families within each primary metric
statistics.zero_variance: Descriptive difference only; no significance or equivalence claim

outcome_accounting: Retain Victory, Death, Censored and Error independently; no longer-fight failure or nerf merely because Guardian fights last longer. Contract violations fail independently of encounter duration.
storage: Tencent cloud execution; download and verify each completed unit on local G drive before reclaiming passed cloud raw files; retain source/runtime needed by active units, metadata, receipts and failed records.
balance_change_recommendation: NoChange unless an independently reproduced current contract defect is observed; do not infer a buff or nerf from these effect deltas alone.
